text:
alex: na1 cluster seeing sustained GPU queueing since ~08:02 UTC, p99 latency up 3-4x, KV cache eviction rate spiking
maria_ops: confirm dashboards - kvcache eviction + batch latency correlate, a few hosts showing OOM restarts
sahil: hitting this now on my traces — batching window seems to grow, lots of small requests getting coalesced badly
ingrid: noticed autoscaler didn't add new hotpool nodes, quota errors in cloud logs around 08:05 
carla: network flaps in na1 edge reported earlier, might be causing uneven request fanout to a subset of hosts
alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) force route traffic off the 3 most overloaded hosts, 2) temporarily disable continuous batching, 3) bump hotpool with reserved instances (if quota)
maria_ops: +1. routing: I'll update routing table to move 30% of traffic to na2 and eu-west staging to keep costs down. executing now.
ingrid: disabling batching flag on runtime controllers (rolling) — command: 
```kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/router ENABLE_CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/router
```
carla: routing change applied, 28% => na2, 12% => eu-west, remaining spread. watching.
sahil: also setting kvcache_ttl to 60s temporarily to reduce eviction churn: 
```curl -X POST https://ops-internal/config -d '{"kvcache_ttl":60}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
alex: cloud quota blocking p4d spin-up, filed urgent quota request with cloud-support (ticket 987654). if they reject, fallback to adding more cheaper a10x instances and increase batch concurrency cap.
maria_ops: autoscaler logs show 403 from compute API at 08:06 with message `Quota exceeded: GPUs`. Added note to ticket.
ops-bot: [alert] Incident created: INC-2026-0453 - na1 GPU queueing / kvcache evictions. Pager duty: oncall-eng-infra.
ingrid: after routing and disabling batching, p99 dropped ~40% in the last 2 minutes. still higher than baseline but trending down.
sahil: reduced batch window fixed a lot of tail cases for small requests. we should dogfood a setting matrix to avoid global disable next time.
carla: cost note: routing to eu-west will add egress and cross-region costs. estimate +$1.4k / hr while we stabilize. flagging in ticket.
alex: agreed — short-term cost accepted to restore SLO. follow-ups: 1) investigate why autoscaler didn't retry on quota error, 2) understand root cause for batch growth (runtime regression candidate), 3) rollback kvcache_ttl after warm-up
maria_ops: creating follow-up tasks in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0453. tagging eng-runtime and infra-quotas.
ops-bot: [update] 1859123550 - mitigation status: routing + batching disable + kvcache_ttl applied. latency improving, monitoring for 30m before full close.
alex: thanks all. if latency flattens to baseline we can re-enable batching as a gradual rollout and revert routing within 1h.
sahil: will run targeted load with small-request workload to validate batching fixes before enabling.
carla: keeping this thread open for postmortem notes.
ops-bot: [reminder] add all command outputs and config diffs to incident doc for audit.
